name: FrameFix
description: Practice-mode input timing correction within a configurable tick window.

enabled.name: Enable FrameFix
enabled.description: Master switch. Turning it off delivers any held-back inputs in order and restores normal input handling with zero added latency.

mode.name: Correction mode
mode.description: <cy>Smart</c>: shifts an input only when the predictor says it helps (currently the predictor is a stub, so Smart leaves inputs unchanged). <cy>Random</c>: randomly shifts inputs for practice (separate from Smart, they never run together). <cy>Disabled</c>: no correction.

practice-only.name: Practice mode only
practice-only.description: Only correct inputs while Practice Mode is on. Recommended.

window.name: Correction window (ticks)
window.description: Maximum shift in either direction when <cy>Symmetric</c> is on. 0 = no correction and no added latency. Ticks are physics steps, not rendered frames.

symmetric.name: Symmetric correction
symmetric.description: On: the window above applies to both directions. Off: use the separate earlier/later limits below.

max-early.name: Max ticks earlier
max-early.description: Used when Symmetric is off. Adds this many ticks of constant input latency (see README, Timing model). 0 = no added latency.

random-probability.name: Random: probability (%)
random-probability.description: Chance that an eligible input gets a random shift. The shift is then picked uniformly among the allowed non-zero shifts.

random-direction.name: Random: direction
random-direction.description: Restricts which shifts Random may pick. Later only adds no latency.

random-seed.name: Random: seed
random-seed.description: Same seed + same settings + same inputs = same random choices.

reseed-on-restart.name: Random: reseed on every restart
reseed-on-restart.description: Restart the random sequence from the seed on each attempt, so attempts are reproducible.

debug-log.name: Debug log
debug-log.description: Write one line per input to the Geode log: original tick, scheduled tick, shift, reason. Off by default.
